style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern shared home before neighborhood cleanup. One healthy adult lounges comfortably on cushioned sofa, feet resting on ottoman, eating snacks and enjoying a hand fan while lazily waving away a broom being offered by another adult. Beside the sofa are his own unfinished pile of laundry and full trash basket. Through open doorway two family members actively sweep and carry bags for the cleanup. Lounging person is visibly awake, cheerful and choosing comfort over an easy fair share of work, not ill injured elderly exhausted or resting after work. Clear contrast liking leisure and refusing labor, no ridicule of poverty. Sensible limbs and hands, snack grip, stable sofa ottoman, feet supported, broom bristles on floor, perspective coherent. 3:2 landscape graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper; no readable text brands logos letters numbers or watermarks.
alt: 家人忙著掃地整理，一名大人卻躺在沙發吃零食、搧扇子，揮手拒絕遞來的掃帚，身旁家事仍堆著未做。
